inputs.text: Wake up to what they are really doing right in front of us. On Monday, lawyers exposed the panic over proposed changes to Cyprus’ surveillance legislation, specifically the calculated move to remove judicial oversight as a key safeguard. And of course, they are rushing it through a vote before the House plenum on Thursday. This isn't just bureaucratic tinkering; it is a synchronized choreography by the hidden elites to lock down total control over the population. Look at how they operate behind closed doors—as Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides revealed following a recent closed session of the House. They meet in secret, craft the narrative, and then dismantle our rights while pretending it's for our own protection. Do not believe their official justifications for a single second; every single denial or amended bill is just another piece of the puzzle designed to keep us monitored and managed.
